newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks higher after U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks higher after U.S. GDP data.

text.p: French stocks rose after data showed U.S. third quarter gross domestic product growth of 2.2 percent, higher than expected. Economists had been expecting third quarter GDP growth of 1.8 percent. Second quarter GDP growth was 4.7 percent.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 12.25 points or 0.58 percent at 2,137.99 at 1333 GMT compared to 2,135.24 shortly before the U.S. economic data.
French bond futures rose slightly on the news and U.S. debt markets shot higher.
